CHAI RAVE presents...

DIWALI ON THE BAY

Consider this your passport to Sausalito.

For one unforgettable daytime to sunset, Chai Rave is taking Diwali to the waterfront - where breathtaking Bay views, golden hour and sunset become part of the celebration.

☀️ THE EXPERIENCE🌊 Breathtaking waterfront views
🌅 Golden hour into sunset
🪔 Diwali Decor
✨ Indo-Western / Festive Chic
🍸 Cocktails + Brunch & Sweets
🎶 Chai Rave sounds into the night
✨ Henna

📍 ERIA: WATERFRONT EXPERIENCEFor the first-time ever, get ready to experience the breathtaking Eria in Sausalito, CA. An incredible rooftop venue, on the water. Part indoor, part outdoor, the venue offer magnificent views of the bay and a second to non atmosphere.

👗 ATTIRE: INDO-WESTERN or FESTIVAL CHICCome dressed in elevated Indo-Western fits — where South Asian style meets modern fashion OR European chic. Hoodies and T-shirts are not allowed. Guests who do not follow the dress code will be refused entry, and tickets will not be refunded.

🎶 LINEUP & MUSICIf you love good music, you've come to the right place. Expect a high-energy fusion of Indian, Afrohouse, iconic EDM anthems, and Global Music — all blended seamlessly into a soundscape that hits different.

Chai Rave is not a Bollywood party. Expect a mix of Indo-house, Afrohouse, EDM, and music from around the world.

🌎 EVERYONE IS WELCOMEYou do not have to be Indian to attend!
Chai Rave is a global experience and open to all communities, all cultures and all ethnicities. Whether you celebrate Diwali every year or this is your first time experiencing the Festival of Lights, come vibe with us where light defeats darkness. 

🎟️ SECURE YOUR TICKETS
Tickets are limited, and prices will increase as each tier sells out.
